gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma based on clinical evidence and radiographic (MRI) imaging.

candidate_evidence.quote: Omburtamab is a murine IgG1 monoclonal antibody, recognizing CD276 (also known as B7-H3).
The aim of this trial is to determine the efficacy and safety of 131I-omburtamab in patients with DIPG that have not progressed following external beam radiation therapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Clinical and/or radiographic (MRI) progression of tumor in the period between external beam radiation therapy and signing of ICF.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: SPECT/CT scans and blood sampling for dosimetry: SPECT/CT scans will be performed at 4h, 12h, 24h, 72h and 7 days after the first administration of 131I-omburtamab.

role_evidence.quote: The aim of this trial is to determine the efficacy and safety of 131I-omburtamab in patients with DIPG that have not progressed following external beam radiation therapy.

agents.drug_class_hint: iodine-131 radiolabelled murine anti-CD276 (B7-H3) monoclonal antibody (isotope 131I), given by convection-enhanced delivery

coder_notes: Diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma only (paediatric, ages 3 to under 21), so not glioblastoma. Candidate fields filled for completeness. device_dependent set true under R4 because the registered CED device (catheter infusion) is paired with the candidate; formulation_flag new_route (convection-enhanced delivery). SPECT/CT and blood dosimetry are planned but the record does not say whether tumour concentration is measured, hence tumour_pk unclear. CD276 is the antibody target but is not an eligibility or other biomarker in the record.
